payload.title: Creating Murmuration Plots for Glacial Data
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates the use of the Pyleoclim library to calculate correlations between speleothem oxygen isotope data and insolation at various latitudes, focusing on glacial periods. It includes defining a function to handle correlations in records with large hiatuses, creating insolation curves using Climlab, and generating glacial period-specific data records. The notebook culminates in the creation of murmuration plots to visualize these correlations.
goals: Calculate correlations between speleothem data and insolation.
Handle records with large hiatuses in correlation analysis.
Generate murmuration plots for glacial data.

section_blurbs.blurb: This section introduces the notebook's purpose of using Pyleoclim to correlate speleothem data with insolation and create murmuration plots, focusing on glacial periods.
